d: We are looking for an experienced, results-driven, and strategic Regional Distribution Manager to oversee and strengthen distribution operations across an assigned geographical region. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing distribution strategies, managing distributor relationships, optimizing product availability, improving market coverage, and ensuring efficient product movement across the regional distribution network.

This role requires strong leadership, distribution management, commercial understanding, and the ability to drive regional business growth through effective channel management and operational excellence.
Develop and execute regional distribution strategies aligned with organizational sales and business objectives.
Manage and expand the regional distribution network by identifying and onboarding new distributors, dealers, and channel partners.
Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors, wholesalers, retailers, and key business partners.
Monitor regional distribution performance, sales targets, market coverage, and product availability.
Ensure effective product distribution and timely delivery across assigned territories.
Develop regional distribution plans, sales forecasts, and inventory requirements.
Analyze market demand, sales trends, and distribution gaps to identify growth opportunities.
Monitor distributor performance and ensure compliance with company policies, commercial terms, and operational standards.
Optimize distribution routes, logistics processes, and inventory movement to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
Coordinate with sales, supply chain, warehouse, procurement, and logistics teams to ensure smooth distribution operations.
Identify opportunities to improve market penetration, distribution reach, and channel productivity.
Conduct regular market visits to evaluate distributor performance, product availability, and retail execution.
Resolve distributor-related issues, operational challenges, and channel conflicts.
Monitor competitor distribution strategies and regional market developments.
Prepare regional distribution reports, performance dashboards, and management presentations.
Lead, guide, and motivate regional distribution teams to achieve business objectives.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field.
5–8 years of relevant experience in Distribution Management, Regional Sales, Channel Management, or Supply Chain Operations.
Proven experience managing distributors, dealers, wholesalers, and regional distribution networks.
Strong understanding of distribution channels, inventory management, and logistics operations.
Experience in regional sales planning, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
Strong negotiation, leadership, and relationship management skills.
